description: Na₂USiO₆ is Esseneite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/acd space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.47 Å. U is bonded to six O atoms to form UO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.23 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-34°. There are two shorter (1.65 Å) and two longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one U, and one Si atom.
